name: ai-mock-interviewer
description: Local-first, voice-led technical mock interview coach with offline and optional AI feedback.

scripts.sync:actual-interviews: node scripts/sync-actual-interview-mock-set.js && node scripts/generate-full-qa-document.js && node scripts/audit-answer-quality.js && node scripts/generate-txt-exports.js && ../.venv/bin/python scripts/build-docx.py && node scripts/build-actual-interview-qa.js && ../.venv/bin/python scripts/build-actual-interview-docx.py
scripts.check:release: npm test && npm run audit:answer-quality && npm run check:production
scripts.stop: lsof -ti:${PORT:-3030} | xargs kill 2>/dev/null || echo 'No process running on port '${PORT:-3030}
